mapper.select:
select fur.id as file_upload_manager_id, fur.user_id,fur.file_task_name as review_name, (select real_name from auth_info where user_id = fur.user_id AND auth_status = '5' order by auth_time desc limit 1) user_name, fur.leader_teacher_id, fur.team_code, fur.team_name,fur.file_info, (select real_name from auth_info where user_id = fur.leader_teacher_id AND auth_status = '5' order by auth_time desc limit 1) as leader_teacher_name, cai.competition_series_id, cai.competition_name,fur.competition_stage_id, fur.competition_stage_name, cai.competition_track_name, cai.competition_track_id as competition_track_code, cai.second_level_code, cai.second_level_name,cai.school as school_id, rti.review_id, rti.review_name, rti.review_start_time, rti.review_end_time, rti.review_desc, rti.review_group_id, rti.reference_document, rti.create_by, rti.create_time, rti.update_by, rti.update_time, rti.version, rti.del_flag, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_task_specialist_relation rtsr WHERE rtsr.review_id = rti.review_id AND rtsr.del_flag = '0' ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS distribute_status from file_upload_manager fur left join review_task_info rti on fur.id = rti.file_upload_manager_id and rti.del_flag = '0'
left join competition_apply_info cai on fur.user_id = cai.user_id and fur.team_code = cai.team_code where rti.review_id = #{reviewId} and rti.del_flag = '0' and cai.competition_role_name = '队长'

select fur.id as file_upload_manager_id, fur.user_id,fur.file_task_name as review_name, (select real_name from auth_info where user_id = fur.user_id AND auth_status = '5' order by auth_time desc limit 1) user_name, fur.leader_teacher_id, fur.team_code, fur.team_name,fur.file_info, (select real_name from auth_info where user_id = fur.leader_teacher_id AND auth_status = '5' order by auth_time desc limit 1) as leader_teacher_name, cai.competition_series_id, cai.competition_name,fur.competition_stage_id, fur.competition_stage_name, cai.competition_track_name, cai.competition_track_id as competition_track_code, cai.second_level_code, cai.second_level_name,cai.school as school_id, rti.review_id, rti.review_start_time, rti.review_end_time, rti.review_desc, rti.review_group_id, rti.reference_document, rti.create_by, rti.create_time, rti.update_by, rti.update_time, rti.version, rti.del_flag,nci.school_name,nci.province,nci.province_code, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_task_specialist_relation rtsr WHERE rtsr.review_id = rti.review_id AND rtsr.del_flag = '0' ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS distribute_status from review_task_info rti inner join file_upload_manager fur on fur.id = rti.file_upload_manager_id
left join competition_apply_info cai on fur.user_id = cai.user_id and fur.team_code = cai.team_code left join nationwide_college_info nci on cai.school = nci.id where EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_task_specialist_relation rtsr WHERE rtsr.review_id = rti.review_id AND rtsr.user_id = #{userId} AND rtsr.del_flag = '0' ) and rti.del_flag = '0'

mapper.select:
SELECT a.rela_id , a.review_id, a.user_id, IFNULL(rr.review_status,'0')as review_status, b.review_start_time, b.review_end_time, c.id as processed_id, c.new_file_name, e.competition_name ,e.competition_track_name ,e.second_level_name FROM review_task_specialist_relation a LEFT JOIN review_task_info b ON a.review_id = b.review_id AND b.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN review_processed_relation c ON b.file_upload_manager_id = c.manager_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN file_upload_manager d ON c.manager_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN competition_apply_info e ON e.team_code = d.team_code and e.user_id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN review_record rr on rr.del_flag = '0' and rr.expert_id = a.user_id and rr.file_id = c.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND c.id = #{processedStr}
AND c.new_file_name like CONCAT('%', #{newFileName}, '%')
AND e.competition_name like CONCAT('%', #{competitionName}, '%')
AND ( e.competition_track_name like CONCAT('%', #{competitionTrackName}, '%') or e.second_level_name like CONCAT('%', #{competitionTrackName}, '%') )
AND rr.review_status = '1'
AND (rr.review_status = '0' or rr.review_status is null)
ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id,c.new_file_name as newFileName,c.new_url as newUrl,b.review_start_time as reviewStartTime, b.review_end_time as reviewEndTime,b.review_desc as reviewDesc,b.reference_document as referenceDocument, IFNULL(rr.last_page,'') as lastPage,rr.review_time as reviewTime,IFNULL(rr.review_status,'0')as review_status, e.competition_name ,e.competition_track_name ,e.second_level_name FROM review_processed_relation c LEFT JOIN review_task_info b ON b.file_upload_manager_id = c.manager_id LEFT JOIN review_processed_relation cc ON b.file_upload_manager_id = cc.manager_id AND cc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN file_upload_manager d ON cc.manager_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN competition_apply_info e ON e.team_code = d.team_code AND e.user_id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN review_record rr ON rr.del_flag = '0' AND rr.expert_id = #{expertId} AND rr.file_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review_id as reviewId, file_upload_manager_id as fileUploadManagerId, review_start_time as reviewStartTime, review_end_time as reviewEndTime FROM review_task_info rti JOIN review_processed_relation rpr ON rti.file_upload_manager_id = rpr.manager_id WHERE rpr.id = #{relationId}

SELECT c.user_id FROM review_processed_relation a JOIN review_task_info b ON b.file_upload_manager_id = a.manager_id AND b.del_flag = '0' JOIN review_task_specialist_relation c ON c.review_id = b.review_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.id = #{processedId} AND c.user_id = #{expertId} AND a.del_flag = '0'
